note: Every count this repo's prose states about itself, and the phrasings that carry it. check.py computes each kind from disk (the truth for each name lives in its TRUTHS table) and fails any stated number that disagrees. A number on a front page is a claim, and a claim no kind here anchors is a claim nothing checks — so a front page states only the kinds in this file, and a new kind is added here first. {NUM} matches a digit string or a number word in either language; {NUM_EN} is the same with a left word boundary, for English. A pattern must anchor to its noun, so that a number in a spoken script is never read as inventory, and every kind carries examples that check.py proves its patterns match — a table that cannot check itself is ADR-0008's failure with extra steps. Kept as data because it changes every time a document lands, and check.py --list prints it.
